description: This Java class, CustomerOptionPopulator, is responsible for converting or populating CustomerOption objects with data extracted from core model CustomerOption objects and associated data such as customer option values, within the context of a specific merchant store and language.

classes.name: CustomerOptionPopulator
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractDataPopulator to convert core CustomerOption entities to web admin CustomerOption data transfer objects, including associated customer option values

methods.name: getOptionSet
methods.description: Returns the current CustomerOptionSet used during population

methods.name: setOptionSet
methods.description: Sets the CustomerOptionSet to be used during population

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates a CustomerOption DTO from the core CustomerOption model, adding associated option value data based on the current option set, store, and language
